newsitem.title: FRANCE: French social security deficit 37.24 bln Ffr - union.
newsitem.headline: French social security deficit 37.24 bln Ffr - union.

text.p: French union Force Ouvriere said it had seen a document prepared for a meeting of France's social security accounts commission, Accoss, that estimated the 1997 social security deficit at 37.24 billion francs.
Accoss could not be reached to confirm the figures.
The welfare system uses payroll charges to fund health care, pensions and family benefits.

A leaked handover letter from former prime minister Alain Juppe to Prime Minister Lionel Jospin, dated June 2, said the central social security accounts would show a deficit some five billion francs more than the 30 billion francs originally expected. Juppe said there was a deficit of a further five billion in other social security accounts.
